policy.label: PPO · Flawed hover bonus · seed 0 · best_validation.zip (200,704 transitions)

indexing: frame k = state after k steps (frame 0 = reset); row k's action/reward produced frame k; time = k/fps

observation_fields.label: Horizontal position
observation_fields.description: (x - W/2) / (W/2) with W = 20 world units. 0 is the pad centre; |x| >= 1 ends the episode (out of bounds).

observation_fields.label: Vertical position
observation_fields.description: (y - (pad_y + LEG_DOWN/SCALE)) / (H/2) with H = 13.33 world units. 0 is roughly leg-on-pad height; ~1.4 at spawn.

observation_fields.label: Horizontal velocity
observation_fields.description: vx_world * (W/2) / FPS (= 0.2 * world units per second). Not an SI quantity.

observation_fields.label: Vertical velocity
observation_fields.description: vy_world * (H/2) / FPS (~0.133 * world units per second). Negative is falling. Not an SI quantity.

observation_fields.label: Angle
observation_fields.description: Body angle in radians (unnormalized). 0 is upright; shown in degrees as a secondary presentation.

observation_fields.label: Left leg contact
observation_fields.description: 1.0 while this leg's contact flag is set. Gymnasium calls it the left leg; physically it is the leg on the +x side (screen right).

observation_fields.label: Right leg contact
observation_fields.description: 1.0 while this leg's contact flag is set. Gymnasium calls it the right leg; physically it is the leg on the -x side (screen left).

scene.units: world (Box2D) units; the simulation is 2-D in the x-y plane

reward_config.name: Flawed hover bonus
reward_config.description: training_reward = original_reward + bonus * eligible(s'). Intentionally flawed: it pays for remaining in a desirable intermediate state, which can compete with finishing the landing.

terms_note: Additional terms are what the training reward would have added on this episode, computed with the same pure functions as training. The policy acted on observations only.

fields.probs: action probabilities for NOOP, LEFT, MAIN, RIGHT
fields.entropy: entropy of that distribution in nats (uniform over 4 actions: ln 4 = 1.386)
fields.value: the critic's state value V(s): expected discounted return of the TRAINING reward

policy_diagnostics.indexing: row k holds what the network computed on the observation of frame k-1, the one row k's action was chosen from
